ycy git
Git utilities
Usage:
  ycy git [flags]
Commands:
  cm	Generate an Angular-style commit message from uncommitted changes
  fork	Download a repo without git history (supports GitHub/GitLab, public/private)
  heat	Show frequently changed files and directories in recent commits
  pulse	Show recent Git activity across repositories
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for git
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
